item.title: EplayerX 1.2.10
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 改善媒体服务器地址解析与编辑，支持带端口及反向代理路径的地址。 - 修复 WebDAV 未指定路径时连接到错误目录的问题，并改善 Silo 地址识别。 - 修复将剧集标记为已观看后，Trakt 下一集可能从继续观看中消失的问题。 - 修复关闭系统“自然滚动”后，播放器触控板横向拖动的快进快退方向。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Improved media server address parsing and editing, including addresses with ports and reverse proxy paths. - Fixed WebDAV connections using the wrong directory when no path is specified, and improved Silo address handling. - Fixed Trakt's next episode disappearing from Continue Watching after marking an episode as watched. - Fixed the direction of horizontal trackpad seeking when Natural Scrolling is disabled in System Settings.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
